source_row.stem: A client is found to have a thyroid nodule on physical exam, and a family member assumes the next step must automatically be surgery to remove it right away. The nurse should anticipate that further evaluation will likely instead include:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Immediate surgical removal with no prior testing, similar to what the family member is currently assuming would happen next","B":"Thyroid function tests and imaging, such as ultrasound, with possible biopsy depending on findings","C":"No further evaluation is needed, since nodules are assumed by some to typically be benign, contrary to the evaluation this finding actually warrants","D":"Just a visual inspection with fairly little testing, which understates the actual evaluation this kind of finding typically requires"}}
source_row.rationale: Evaluation of a thyroid nodule typically includes thyroid function tests and imaging such as ultrasound, with fine-needle aspiration biopsy considered based on nodule characteristics and risk factors.
source_row.source_name: American Thyroid Association — Thyroid Nodule Management Guideline
